title: xStocks Anthropic Token begins Solana trading post-IPO Access delays
digest:
xStocks announced the Solana trading launch of its stock-linked yield token ANTx on Nov 20, 2026, after failing to fully meet IPO Access requirements. The token offers Solana-based exposure to stock market returns without shareholder rights. 

The trading activation followed a 24-hour delay in fulfilling all IPO Access obligations, with xStocks citing regulatory compliance adjustments as the reason. Early market data shows ANTx trading at $0.87 with 12% daily volatility, though the token remains unlisted on major exchanges. 

xStocks emphasized that the Solana platform's lower fees and faster transaction times justify the shift, though the IPO Access shortcomings highlight regulatory hurdles in decentralized exchange integrations.
